plain_summary_en: This paper studies AI for Democracy? How Public Service Media Around the World Use Artificial Intelligence to Produce Journalism. In plain terms, it asks what is happening, why it matters for public communication, and what evidence the authors use. The likely focus is Journalism, Public service, Public relations, Political science. The abstract suggests a mixed methods approach, which makes the work useful for understanding how communication changes in everyday life.
